const products=[{"id": 1, "name": "قلم Pen", "category": "office", "price": 5}, {"id": 2, "name": "كتاب", "category": "books", "price": 20}, {"id": 3, "name": "دفتر", "category": "office", "price": 10}, {"id": 4, "name": "سماعة", "category": "tech", "price": 50}];
function setup(){const input=document.querySelector('#catalog-query'),category=document.querySelector('#catalog-category'),sort=document.querySelector('#catalog-sort'),list=document.querySelector('#products');function render(){let visible=products.filter(p=>p.name.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(input.value.trim().toLocaleLowerCase())&&(category.value==='all'||p.category===category.value));if(sort.value==='asc')visible=[...visible].sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price);list.textContent='';for(const p of visible){const li=document.createElement('li');li.className='product';const name=document.createElement('span');name.className='product-name';name.textContent=p.name;li.append(name,document.createTextNode(' '+p.price));list.append(li)}document.querySelector('#matches').textContent=String(visible.length);document.querySelector('#catalog-empty').textContent=visible.length?'':'لا توجد نتائج'}input.addEventListener('input',render);category.addEventListener('change',render);sort.addEventListener('change',render);render()}

const records=[{"region": "east", "revenue": 120, "orders": 3}, {"region": "west", "revenue": 90, "orders": 3}, {"region": "east", "revenue": 40, "orders": 1}];
function setup(){const region=document.querySelector('#region'),minimum=document.querySelector('#min-revenue');function render(){const min=Number(minimum.value)||0;const rows=records.filter(r=>(region.value==='all'||r.region===region.value)&&r.revenue>=min);const revenue=rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.revenue,0),orders=rows.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.orders,0);document.querySelector('#revenue').textContent=revenue.toFixed(2);document.querySelector('#orders').textContent=String(orders);document.querySelector('#average').textContent=(orders?revenue/orders:0).toFixed(2);document.querySelector('#rows').textContent=String(rows.length);const chart=document.querySelector('#chart');chart.textContent='';for(const r of rows){const bar=document.createElement('p');bar.className='chart-bar';bar.setAttribute('data-value',String(r.revenue));bar.style.cssText='background:#b7ddc8;padding:8px;width:'+r.revenue/120*100+'%;max-width:100%';bar.textContent=r.region+': '+r.revenue;chart.append(bar)}}region.addEventListener('change',render);minimum.addEventListener('input',render);render()}
